name: Gossamer Bridge of Moonlit Silk
description: A delicate bridge woven from spider‑silk threads that glow with moonlight, spanning a chasm of glowing fungi.
prompt: A slender suspension bridge made of ultra‑fine, iridescent silk strands stretching across a deep chasm. The silk glows with a soft silver‑blue moonlight. Below, the chasm walls are covered in bioluminescent fungi in greens and blues. Mist rises gently. Ethereal, high detail, fantasy illustration style, 8K.
caption: Cross on threads spun by the night 🌙🕸️ #SilkBridge
